mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an easing monetary policy, which reduces discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in less than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5% for three consecutive months, it signals restrictive monetary policy that increases equity discount rates and reduces valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in less than 40% of triggered instances, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate and increase in nonfarm payrolls indicates labor market strength that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint effect of UNRATE decline and PAYEMS increase fails to produce positive 20d returns in more than 50% of cases, or interaction term coefficient is not statistically significant (p>0.05) in rolling regression.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime defined by housing starts above 1,800 thousand units and quarterly GDP growth above 11,300 billion dollars, the S&P 500 underperforms due to overvaluation and rising rate expectations, causing negative forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in less than 40% of triggered instances, or joint condition fails to show significant negative returns in 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A declining unemployment rate signals tightening labor market conditions that increase wage pressures and corporate costs, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 40% of instances when UNRATE declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI inflation exceeds 3.0%, it signals persistent inflation requiring hawkish monetary policy, which increases equity discount rates and causes negative S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in less than 40% of triggered instances, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in industrial production and real personal consumption expenditures signals robust economic growth that increases corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint increase in INDPRO and RSAFS fails to produce positive 20d returns in more than 50% of cases, or interaction term coefficient is not statistically significant (p>0.05) in rolling regression.

mechanism_narrative: In a housing market recovery regime defined by housing starts above 1,800 thousand units, the S&P 500 outperforms due to increased consumer confidence and spending, producing positive forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in less than 40% of instances when HOUST > 1800, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 1-year rolling window.
